BCCI Ombudsman issues notice to Hyderabad Cricket Association

The BCCI Ombudsman has issued a notice to the Hyderabad Cricket Association (HCA) in response to a complaint regarding its governance. The notice signifies an inquiry into the internal affairs and management practices of the HCA. This action by the BCCI Ombudsman highlights potential issues within the association's operational framework.
